preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.label_preset WHERE is_system = true)

changeSet.comment: Re-seed system label presets still at the fallback set from the real legacy site_information keys (OGC-1219)
changeSet.sql: WITH normalized AS ( SELECT name, CASE WHEN value ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN value::INTEGER ELSE NULL END AS num FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name ~ '^(height|width|numDefault|numMax)(Order|Specimen|Block|Slide|Freezer)Labels$' ), legacy AS ( SELECT seed.preset_name, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'height' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS height_mm, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'width' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS width_mm, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'numDefault' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS default_qty, (SELECT num FROM normalized WHERE name = 'numMax' || seed.legacy_type || 'Labels') AS max_qty FROM (VALUES ('Order', 'Order Label'), ('Specimen', 'Specimen Label'), ('Block', 'Block Label'), ('Slide', 'Slide Label'), ('Freezer', 'Freezer Label') ) AS seed(legacy_type, preset_name) ) UPDATE clinlims.label_preset p SET height_mm = LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, COALESCE(l.height_mm, p.height_mm))), width_mm = LEAST(200, GREATEST(5, COALESCE(l.width_mm, p.width_mm))), default_per_order = CASE WHEN p.prints_per_order THEN COALESCE(l.default_qty, p.default_per_order) ELSE p.default_per_order END, max_per_order = CASE WHEN p.prints_per_order THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(l.max_qty, p.max_per_order), COALESCE(l.default_qty, p.default_per_order)) ELSE p.max_per_order END, default_per_sample = CASE WHEN p.prints_per_order THEN p.default_per_sample ELSE COALESCE(l.default_qty, p.default_per_sample) END, max_per_sample = CASE WHEN p.prints_per_order THEN p.max_per_sample ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(l.max_qty, p.max_per_sample), COALESCE(l.default_qty, p.default_per_sample)) END, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM legacy l WHERE p.is_system = true AND p.name = l.preset_name AND p.height_mm = 25 AND p.width_mm = 76 AND ( (p.prints_per_order AND p.default_per_order = 1 AND p.max_per_order = 10) OR (NOT p.prints_per_order AND p.default_per_sample = 1 AND p.max_per_sample = 10) ) AND (l.height_mm IS NOT NULL OR l.width_mm IS NOT NULL OR l.default_qty IS NOT NULL OR l.max_qty IS NOT NULL);
